use: Comparison reference for names, slot offsets and ABI candidates. No reference implementation imported. OEM signatures verified separately from original ARM.
attribution: libgame: Ulrich Hecht (2012, 2013), based on alemaxx (2010); zlib-style license in libgame.c.
differences_in_this_image: MCatchQueryImage consumes three arguments: id, field, uint16_t *output.
NativeGE_fsSeek returns 32-bit status (0/2), not uint64_t position.
MCatchGetFrameBuffer writes dimensions through two uint16_t pointers.
Offset 0x138 returns 0xff in this image; do not treat it as a zero-return stub.
Native API ends at 0x150 (NULL); offset 0x154 is outside this 85-slot table.
